memory_control.title: Memory control
memory_control.mode_ask: Automatic memory asks first: what Dodaios would like to remember waits here until you approve each note.
memory_control.mode_off: Automatic memory is off. Nothing new is proposed or saved by itself.
memory_control.mode_direct: Automatic memory saves notes without asking (you turned approval off).
memory_control.proposals_hint: A waiting note is not used and not sent anywhere until you approve it. Approve, edit, or reject each one.
memory_control.prov_unlabelled: no privacy label, kept on this device
memory_control.trash_hint: These pages are hidden from memory and search. They are removed for good after the date shown.
memory_control.export_hint: A zip of this product's pages. Later deletions do not change a copy you already made.
memory_control.backups_fact: Backups: a copy is taken before each memory change and the newest {count} are kept. Rotation counts copies, not days.
memory_control.archive_is_not_delete: Delete is different from Archive. Archive only moves the page aside and keeps it.
memory_control.mode_logical: Delete, with undo for 30 days. The page is hidden from memory, search and recall, and kept in the trash.
memory_control.mode_permanent: Delete for good. The page and its search and meaning-search entries are removed. There is no undo.
memory_control.stays_backups: Backup copies keep the page until they rotate out.
memory_control.stays_exports: Exports you already made keep their copy.
memory_control.stays_remote: Anything already sent to an online engine in earlier chats cannot be taken back.
memory_control.stays_derived: Other pages that mention or repeat it are listed, not changed.
memory_control.derived_title: These pages mention or repeat it (not changed)
